    [4.082777, 4.082777, 1.360926],

    [4.082777, 1.360926, 4.082777],
    [0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000],
    [1.360926, 4.082777, 4.082777],
    [2.721851, 2.721851, 0.000000],
    [1.360926, 1.360926, 1.360926],
    [2.721851, 0.000000, 2.721851]
])

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicated_positions = []
for i in range(3):
    for j in range(3):
        for k in range(3):
            for pos in positions:
                replicated_positions.append(pos + np.array([i, j, k]) * 5.443702)

    f.write('Masses\n\n')
    f.write('1  28.0855\n\n')
